lock.title: Locked users (web application)
lock.db_note: Unlock removes the web application lock AND unlocks the Oracle account (ALTER USER … ACCOUNT UNLOCK) using your own Oracle session. Your Oracle user needs the ALTER USER privilege.
lock.err_oracle: Oracle refused to unlock the account.
lock.oracle_not_found: No such Oracle user – only the app lock was removed
